scientific_integrity: The finite boundary ranks and every signed group-action Lefschetz number are reproduced from the graph definition by standalone exact code. The representation-theoretic deduction is given in full. No independent validation or publication-priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The calculation is for the twenty-vertex Desargues graph only.
Only rational automorphism modules and quotient homology are determined; integral homology lattices and the quotient homotopy type are not claimed.
Unindexed equivalent prior results cannot be ruled out.
title: Complete \(S_5\times C_2\) homology character of the Desargues independence complex
